scope: Existing commerce-admin competitor comparison workspace and additive compatible native backend; development checkpoint only. This does not finish the entire commerce application.

featureMapping.before: Competitor results and local-state price/match/edit panels
featureMapping.preserved: Original catalog/competitor readers, human matching, manual capture, identity/context editing, collection permission and automatic collection, explicit collector, pair removal; typed quantities and original observations now stay distinct.

featureMapping.before: Category review grid and batch reviewed markers
featureMapping.preserved: Category/SKU review queue and actual native reviewed marker. Suggestions never become verified matches automatically. New flow reviews one SKU explicitly; original batch endpoints remain compatible.

Native all-product search, category, legacy vendor-name/position filters, paging and XLSX export. Existing report is explicitly kilogram-scoped; non-kg/ranged/FX/future/unknown-age bases are excluded. It is not a market-completeness claim.

Old query links redirect to distinct action URLs. Collected-item SKU suggestions remain suggestions; manual SKU selection is retained. Source configuration/catalog management use their existing authorized feature URLs.

featureMapping.before: Private pack planning and promotion rehearsal
featureMapping.preserved: Explicit selected IDs, at most 20, revalidated fingerprint and SKU handoff. Pack planner seeds selected observations only after its native source read matches; existing backups need explicit choice. Promotion rehearsal remains admin-only. No price/cost/activation assumptions are silently copied.

permissions.businessAnalyst: Original GET-only guard remains authoritative; no write controls or POST dispatched.
permissions.merchandising: No new grant; competitor/pricing access dependency remains unresolved.
permissions.receipts: Owner-private request lookup; shared competitor history retains the existing authorized competitor read scope. Login secrets are never projected.

basis.quantity: Exact decimal/rational normalization, native precision boundaries and pack count; no midpoint for a range.
basis.eligible: Known matching fixed unit/pack, THB, VAT-inclusive, separately human-verified same-product identity, current source configuration, valid dates and freshness; member eligibility remains unverified.
excluded: invalid, future, stale or unknown dates
old observation after a pack/identity/context edit
basis.originalEvidence: Raw money/currency/tax/basis/time/pack/context/actor snapshots preserved in the existing immutable action journal. Invalid bases never become THB aliases or ranked price deltas. Legacy history before this journal is unavailable; no historical provenance is invented.

mutations.packet: Strict requestId UUID, SKU, sourceFingerprint and 1..20 commands; pair revision required; no duplicated pair intent or actor/permission overrides.
mutations.transaction: Shared request advisory lock, product/pair/source locks, authoritative fingerprint/revision validation, savepoints for expected per-item errors; pair edits and durable receipt commit together. Unrecognized SQL/storage failure rolls back the whole transaction.
mutations.collector: Vendor read happens before row locks. Evidence/config/revision is checked again under locks. Replays return the original committed receipt without another vendor fetch. Read/identity/price failures preserve the old observation and persist a failed outcome, never a completed-action count. Existing collector and auto-collection business constraints retained.
mutations.packReplacement: Same pair ID; original observation archived. Native current-price alias cleared on pack/identity edits, match invalidated; later match verification cannot reinterpret the old quote. Legacy grid replacement is in-place and archives atomically.
mutations.receipt: competitor_action kind plus shared scenario.kind discriminator prevents promotion/pack receipt/list readers from treating this as a different draft type. Committed/partial/failed counts reflect applied native actions, not browser intent.
mutations.recovery: Owner-scoped immutable browser packet stored and roundtrip verified before dispatch. Duplicate clicks guarded synchronously. Unknown outcomes require authoritative lookup. Only confirmed 404 permits the exact same packet retry; conflicts require current review. Interrupted saves cannot redirect a newer navigation.

remainingDependencies: Production availability/permissions of existing typed competitor columns, catalog/source copies, commerce_promotion_drafts and request tables have not been verified; unavailable storage remains a retriable error, never success.
The raw observation journal uses existing JSON storage with per-pair lookups; production volume, indexing, retention and query budgets need follow-up using approved production read access.

Native pack observations cap at 200 and history at 20; coverage is explicitly truncated. Legacy source names in retained overview filters are not stable vendor IDs; typed per-product comparison uses stable IDs.

Upstream copy freshness remains unverified; member eligibility, delivery/region/minimum-order/quantity tiers and FX normalization need authoritative contracts. No delivered-price, recommendation, profit, ATP or activation readiness is claimed.

Legacy batch accept/reject endpoints remain compatible; the new typed UI deliberately requires separate human verification and per-SKU review. Further batch ergonomics can follow the canonical action pattern.

Advanced retailer-URL reassignment and batch proposal accept/reject ergonomics are not yet part of the new typed UI. Their legacy backend routes remain compatible; source/catalog management and per-SKU actions are reachable. Do not infer that every old local-state control was rebuilt.
MER competitor grant remains blocked pending an explicit permission decision; OCR-to-cart is cancelled.
Actual Claude/Cursor review is unrun and must occur on dot cloud computer through an authorized same-revision handoff. No credentials were copied and no transfer workaround was used.
validationEvidence: /workspace/commerce-ui-audit-20261009/competitor-verification.json (local verification artifact; final commit/manifest recorded separately)

currentBuiltBrowser.browserAuthentication: Synthetic transport; original real StaffAuthGuard tested in native HTTP suites. No production/full-auth E2E claim.

validation.checksAreSelectedRegressions: No whole-app redesign or full-suite coverage claim. Historical/focused reruns are not added to these counts.
